ontology/builtin/software-engineering.ya.raw:
apiVersion: harness.evopilot.io/v1
kind: OntologyPack
metadata:
  id: software-engineering
  version: 1.1.0
  lifecycle: published
  description: Product-neutral concepts used only to determine Harness asset eligibility and candidate relationships.
spec:
  evidenceKinds:
    - source-code
    - architecture-document
    - build-manifest
    - runtime-log
    - attachment
    - operator-note
    - github-repository
    - historical-harness
    - research-evidence
  concepts:
    - id: distributed-cache
      terms: [distributed cache, redis compatible, key-value store, ttl, eviction, hash slot, failover, cluster cache, 分布式缓存, 键值存储]
      parents: [data-infrastructure]
      conflicts: [redis-client]
    - id: redis-client
      terms: [spring-data-redis, jedis, redis client, redis template, redis serializer, connection factory]
      parents: [client-library]
      conflicts: [distributed-cache]
    - id: database-product
      terms: [database engine, sql parser, query optimizer, transaction, wal, mvcc, storage engine, distributed sql, 数据库内核]
      parents: [data-infrastructure]
      conflicts: [database-client]
    - id: api-gateway
      terms: [api gateway, reverse proxy, route policy, rate limit, upstream, ingress, traffic gateway, 网关, 限流]
      parents: [network-infrastructure]
      conflicts: [http-client]
    - id: scheduler
      terms: [scheduler, job scheduling, cron, task dispatch, worker queue, 调度系统, 任务调度]
      parents: [platform-infrastructure]
    - id: rpc-framework
      terms: [rpc framework, dubbo, grpc, service discovery, remoting, rpc context]
      parents: [network-infrastructure]
    - id: observability
      terms: [apm, tracing, telemetry, metrics, span, observability, 可观测性]
      parents: [platform-infrastructure]
    - id: management-software
      terms: [rbac, admin console, workflow approval, reporting, audit trail, crm, enterprise management]
      parents: [business-application]
    - id: language-service
      terms: [spring boot, java service, golang service, node service, python service, rest controller, code generation, 代码生成, 领域驱动设计, ddd, domain service, facade, manager, mybatis, plantuml, 持久层, 门面层, 业务逻辑]
      parents: [application-runtime]
    - id: executable-engineering
      terms: [build, test, validate, deploy, diagnose, benchmark, migrate, verify, rollback, release]
  roles:
    - id: distributed-cache-product
      domain: distributed-cache
      taskClass: product-engineering
      concepts: [distributed-cache, executable-engineering]
      negativeConcepts: [redis-client]
    - id: redis-client-library
      domain: redis-client
      taskClass: library-engineering
      concepts: [redis-client, executable-engineering]
      negativeConcepts: [distributed-cache]
    - id: database-product
      domain: database
      taskClass: product-engineering
      concepts: [database-product, executable-engineering]
      negativeConcepts: [database-client]
    - id: api-gateway-product
      domain: api-gateway
      taskClass: product-engineering
      concepts: [api-gateway, executable-engineering]
      negativeConcepts: [http-client]
    - id: scheduler-platform
      domain: scheduler
      taskClass: platform-engineering
      concepts: [scheduler, executable-engineering]
    - id: rpc-framework
      domain: rpc-framework
      taskClass: framework-engineering
      concepts: [rpc-framework, executable-engineering]
    - id: observability-platform
      domain: observability
      taskClass: platform-engineering
      concepts: [observability, executable-engineering]
    - id: enterprise-management-application
      domain: management-software
      taskClass: application-engineering
      concepts: [management-software, executable-engineering]
    - id: language-service
      domain: language-service
      taskClass: service-engineering
      concepts: [language-service, executable-engineering]
